verdict.rationale: HumanLayer has no sandbox of its own. It lets agent sessions run on a remote daemon host you supply, such as a cloud VM (docs-7, docs-27, docs-31), and gives each task its own git worktree (docs-26, docs-32). That means isolation is possible only by provisioning and locking down your own separate machine, and the docs actually advise giving the host access to credentials and private services rather than isolating it. Missing for 10: a built-in or managed isolated sandbox for code execution, documented controls for installing dependencies safely, network or credential isolation guarantees, and any independent hands-on corroboration.
